bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.aTier: Existing elite regime profile; normal allowed size.
bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.bTier: Positive-expectancy best-acceptable entries after A-tier priority while live capacity remains; 25% micro-probation candidate-size multiplier.
bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.rule: Process live qualified A candidates first, then qualified B candidates at no more than 25% encoded normal size while live capacity remains, including after an A fill. Keep scanning after each completed or rejected setup.

runtimeGapGuard.rule: At runtime compare current session open with prior regular-session close when reliable. Skip after an absolute opening gap above 4%, or when the gap consumes more than 50% of planned entry-to-stop distance, unless explicitly revalidated. Never widen the stop.

runtimeLiquidityRanking.rankingBasis: Cost-adjusted expectancy is emphasized and reported spread is penalized before live broker verification. Live Robinhood spread remains authoritative.
runtimeLiquidityRanking.minimumReliableDollarVolume: Prefer highly liquid names; reject clearly illiquid candidates when reliable dollar volume is available.

outcomeGuard.reason: Scanner/model trade-history is diagnostic only. It must never pause or size live Robinhood trading. Live outcome brakes are computed only from confirmed Robinhood fills/history at runtime.

advancedGuards.note: The overall validation status is diagnostic and must not freeze unrelated stock regimes. Block or reduce only the CURRENT runtime regime according to runtimePolicy. MIXED is disabled. CALM remains blocked when its own holdouts fail. Sparse regimes stay reduced. TRENDING_UP stays eligible when its own policy allows it.

opportunityExpansion.rankingBasis: A tier first, then B tier; within each tier emphasize cost-adjusted expectancy, quality, target2 reward/risk, validation depth and liquidity, with explicit spread and volatility penalties.
opportunityExpansion.note: Deeper reserve queue increases opportunity coverage, not portfolio risk. Maximum concurrent positions and portfolio stop-risk ceiling are unchanged.

bestAcceptable.rule: B is a micro-probation fallback capped at one-quarter of normal candidate size, not a waiver. It must still have bullish direction, positive conservative expectancy, adequate history, acceptable R:R, bounded volatility, and every downstream live account/execution/protection guard.

seedLane.rule: Legacy swing stock seed lane is disabled under evidence-first day trading; retained only as configuration history. It may bypass only the forward profitability-admission wait at up to a $30 ceiling for A-tier candidates (raised from $20); a B-tier (best-acceptable) candidate is now also seed-lane eligible but stays capped at $7.50 (25% of the A-tier ceiling), matching this policy's existing B-tier micro-probation sizing elsewhere. Up to 3 concurrent positions and 2 new positions per UTC day (raised from 2/1). Every research, freshness, entry-zone, no-chase, decision-intelligence, buying-power, account-floor, portfolio, duplicate-order and protection gate remains mandatory. LIVE_SUSPENDED and contradictory shadow evidence never qualify. A fractional-only fill (common at this size) has no broker-resident stop available on Robinhood -- this lane uses the same agent-managed synthetic-stop protection already defined for fractional positions elsewhere (fractionalProtectionPolicy), including its tighter 0.75%-of-equity planned-stop-risk cap and mandatory active-monitoring requirement, rather than requiring an impossible broker-resident stop.

dayTradeSeedLane.rule: User-authorized same-day stock seed lane, expanded 2026-09-18 at user request for more trades/day and larger size. It reuses the swing seed candidate pool, never overlaps a swing selection, accepts entries only during the authoritative regular session with at least 20 minutes to close (matching the system-wide day-trader policy), and requires repeated forced-exit dispatches from 10 minutes before close until Robinhood confirms the position is flat. Up to a $30 ceiling for A-tier candidates (raised from $20); a B-tier (best-acceptable) candidate is now also day-trade-seed-lane eligible but stays capped at $7.50 (25% of the A-tier ceiling). Up to 5 concurrent positions and 5 new positions per UTC day (raised from 3/3). A fractional-only fill (common at this size) has no broker-resident stop available on Robinhood -- this lane uses the same agent-managed synthetic-stop protection already defined for fractional positions elsewhere (fractionalProtectionPolicy), including its tighter 0.75%-of-equity planned-stop-risk cap and mandatory active-monitoring requirement, rather than requiring an impossible broker-resident stop. Synthetic protection still requires the same <=5 minute active-monitoring cadence during the regular session as the swing lane, separate from this lane's own forced-exit timing. Profit target tightened 2026-09-22 (user-requested day-trade-only phase): target1/target2 for this lane use targetPct1/targetPct2 (2%/3% above entry) instead of the shared swing 1.5R/2.6R geometry, since the goal is small, frequent, same-day gains rather than a multi-day swing target -- stop/invalidation logic is unchanged.

winningPositionAddOn.rule: A fresh A-tier trigger may add at most $20 to an already-held Teststock stock only when the live position is profitable by at least 1%, no equivalent order is pending, no add-on was submitted for that symbol today, combined portfolio risk remains inside every cap, and protection is preserved or tightened. Never average down or widen the stop.

stockPolicy.instructions: Target2 is the qualification target; target1 is for partial profit/de-risking. Use cost-adjusted conservative expectancy when available so execution friction cannot be ignored. A tier always ranks before B tier. A candidates may use their normal encoded size only after every downstream runtime and broker guard passes. B candidates remain capped at 25% micro-probation size. The automatic seed lane uses only existing dedicated Robinhood cash and can never deposit, transfer, borrow or use margin.
